messages:
Zoe: Morning team! Couple quick onboarding questions as I wrap up week 1.
Zoe: 1) My offer listed a $300 "home office" reimbursement. Do I submit that in Expensify or will it be a payroll item?
Zoe: 2) I enrolled in the HSA-eligible plan but didn't see employer contribution on my stub. Is that delayed?
Zoe: 3) I added my partner as a dependent but the benefits portal still shows "verification required". What docs should I upload?
people-ops-bot: Welcome Zoe! :wave: Links: benefits portal https://benefits.redwood.example, expenses https://expenses.redwood.example, payroll FAQ https://payroll.redwood.example/faq.
Maya (People Ops): Hey Zoe, congrats and welcome. Quick answers: home office called "reimbursement" -> Expensify; "stipend" -> payroll. Which wording exactly is in your offer?
Zoe: In my offer it says: "One-time home office reimbursement up to $300 upon submission of receipts."
Maya (People Ops): Perfect 1 that is a reimbursement. Submit receipts in Expensify, tag "Home-Office-2026" and include the recruiting approval email in the comments so Finance codes it correctly.
Lina (Payroll): Reimbursements via Expensify are processed on the regular reimbursement cycle (usually within 7 business days after approval). They are separate from payroll deposits. If you need an ETA after submitting ping payroll and we can confirm processing.
Priya (Benefits): HSA employer contributions start once your medical election is active. If you enrolled during your 30-day window coverage typically begins the 1st of next month and the employer HSA deposit posts on the first payroll after that effective date. If you enrolled earlier this week it may not show until the next pay period.
Zoe: Got it on HSA. For dependent verification I uploaded a domestic partnership affidavit but portal still shows "verification required". Anything else needed?
Maya (People Ops): The benefits portal will list required docs. For domestic partners we typically need either a domestic partnership affidavit and proof of shared residence (utility bill) OR a certified partnership registration. If you uploaded the affidavit, give it 2 business days; if it still says pending tag this thread and I'll escalate.
Zoe: Thanks 1 I uploaded a utility bill too, so fingers crossed. One more tiny item: do company holidays get prorated for mid-month starts? I started on the 11th.
Maya (People Ops): Company observed holidays are granted to all employees regardless of start date (not prorated). Floating holidays and PTO accruals are prorated based on hire date per the handbook. See PTO policy: https://handbook.redwood.example/pto.
Zoe: Amazing, thanks for the speedy help. I'll submit the Expensify ticket and tag this thread.
Lina (Payroll): If you tag us after you submit we'll confirm the reimbursement code and approximate payment date. Also confirm your direct deposit on Workday > Pay so reimbursement goes to the expected account.
Zoe: Will do, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
